items.prompt: Which guard is safe for nonnegative long long q,p when q>0 and M is max()?

options.text: First multiply q*p, then compare the result with M
options.why: The signed overflow may already have occurred.

options.text: Convert the possibly overflowed result to unsigned afterward
options.why: A later conversion cannot undo earlier undefined behavior.
Division by positive q gives the equivalent representability condition.

options.text: Assume long long can hold any Python integer

items.explanation: Validate nonnegative inputs and handle q=0 before the positive-divisor guard.
